title: A Vow for the Promise
author: Beatrix Iversen
blurb: Emrys Ashgrove, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must forgive the person in the mirror first before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
